texts.csvHelp: Use one CSV per reading. For a single passage, use original_text as before. For a reading with sections, add one row per section using section_order, section_title (optional), and section_text; leave original_text empty. Add question rows as needed. Add vocabulary_words and vocabulary_definitions separated by | on any row to highlight words or phrases; vocabulary_simplifications is optional. Keep the lists in the same order. Line breaks and indentation are preserved.
